options.name: Overused impeachment procedure
options.desc: The impeachment procedure of the government can be easily abused due to a low ecclesial vote threshold and no constitutional requirement of a constitutive vote of no confidence.

options.name: Reformed impeachment procedure
options.desc: The impeachment procedure of the government requires a qualified majority of ecclesial votes and a constitutive vote of no confidence.

options.name: Impeachment removed
options.desc: The legislative can no longer impeach the government.
